title: Foundational-curriculum Step 0 (cheap gateway): streaming corpus loader + stream-cortex learning-faithfulness smoke
type: BUILD + cheap-first de-risk (Step 0). CPU (SIM_BACKEND=numpy). Reuse-by-import, runner-side only, NO sim/ edit.
verdict: Step 0 GO: streaming corpus loader works (bounded-memory, byte-identical, chunk-independent) AND stream-cortex learning is faithful from the streamed shard (corr(M,C)=0.8527 > 0.85, EXACTLY == the whole-file baseline). The gateway to the foundational-curriculum arc is open.

loader_change.design: iter_stories = TRUE streaming generator: reads the file in fixed byte chunks, carries the partial story across chunk boundaries, splits on the <|endoftext|> document delimiter, yields one story's tokens at a time -> peak resident raw text bounded by ~chunk+one-story, INDEPENDENT of total corpus size (the scaling path). load_token_stream = backward-compatible drop-in that returns the SAME list[list[str]] the old whole-file loaders returned (the permutation-based consumers need len()+random access) but is built via iter_stories so the raw file is NEVER read whole into one string.
wired_into: research/runners/_phaseB_onbridge_stream_cortex_derisk.py: load_token_stream() now delegates to corpus_stream (chunked); added --corpus-path (default = wired data/corpus/tinystories.txt fallback).

research/runners/_longitudinal_develop_loop_gpu.py: StreamCortex._load_token_stream() now uses corpus_stream (chunked); added corpus_path through StreamCortex.__init__ / develop_gpu / run_gpu_smoke and a --corpus-path CLI arg (default fallback = byte-identical prior behavior); removed now-unused `import re`.
loader_change.backward_compatible: Yes -- --corpus-path defaults to the same hardcoded data/corpus/tinystories.txt the loaders used; the materialized list is shape-identical, so existing consumers are unaffected.
loader_change.sim_edit: NONE. All three files are under research/runners/. No protected sim/ edit was needed.

shard.provenance: REAL TinyStories shard (NOT synthesized). It is the genuine HuggingFace 'roneneldan/TinyStories' V2-GPT4 validation split, fetched + cleaned + cached by the repo's existing research/runners/corpus_fetch.py (degraded=False). Confirmed by inspection: 9828 <|endoftext|>-delimited simple-English children's narratives ('Once upon a time...'). NOTE: the scoping said this file 'is not in the repo' -- it WAS already present (fetched after the scoping was written), so Step 0 used a REAL corpus shard, the stronger test (no stand-in was synthesized).

streaming_demo.note: Streaming PROVEN: the 7.99 MB file is processed in 122 chunks of 64 KiB via iter_stories; peak resident raw text is 0.365 MB = 0.046x the file size (bounded by chunk+story, NOT total size) vs 15.99 MB for a whole-file read = 43.7x reduction. Story lists are byte-identical to the old whole-file read at BOTH 64 KiB and 997-byte chunks (chunk-size-independent boundary splitting).

smoke_config.runner: research/runners/_phaseB_onbridge_stream_cortex_derisk.py::run_seed (the on-bridge stream-cortex learning-faithfulness smoke; prints corr(M,C))
smoke_config.bridge: 3168 neurons (64*12 target + 200*12 hub), 1843200 hub->target plastic synapses, rate-Hebbian co-occurrence learning

result.honest_note_on_secondary_metrics: The load-bearing Step 0 bar is corr(M,C) > 0.85 (learning fidelity: does the bridge's learned co-occurrence M match the windows it heard?) -- MET (0.8527) and EXACTLY identical streamed-vs-baseline. The secondary code/gen metrics are modest (code +0.084 == 99.7% of host-ref; gen 0.27; permuted ~0 clean) because this is a deliberately REDUCED CPU smoke (2000 windows, n_per=12) -- the standalone derisk at 20000 windows / larger n_per reaches the documented higher values. These are byte-identical between the streamed and whole-file runs, confirming the loader is the ONLY difference and it is lossless; they are NOT a regression introduced by the streaming change.

go_bar: Step 0 GO = streaming loader works (bounded-memory + byte-identical + chunk-independent) AND learning faithful (corr(M,C) > 0.85 on the streamed shard, unchanged vs the hardcoded-corpus baseline). BOTH met.
